name: Spherical Harmonic Volumetric Visibility
definition: A real-time dynamic lighting technique for direct volume rendering that encodes local and global volumetric visibility using spherical harmonic basis functions.
summary: Spherical Harmonic Volumetric Visibility is a real-time dynamic lighting technique for volume rendering that encodes visibility using spherical harmonics stored in a multiresolution grid to efficiently handle directional, point, and environment lights.
